mapper.insert: INSERT INTO setmeal (category_id, name, price, description, image, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user,status) VALUES (#{categoryId},#{name},#{price},#{description},#{image}, #{createTime},#{updateTime},#{createUser},#{updateUser},#{status})
mapper.select: SELECT setmeal.*,category.name as categoryName FROM setmeal LEFT JOIN category on setmeal.category_id = category.id WHERE setmeal.id = #{id}
